topic: Technical build issues and scheduling discussion
summary_markdown: The conversation began with a technical issue regarding a corporate web build. [p1] reported problems with dependencies, suggesting something had expired from the node repository and that the build server was failing to compile. The discussion covered attempts to resolve this locally (cleaning/force-building) and remotely (restarting the build). Later, the conversation shifted entirely to scheduling logistics for a meeting invite, followed by non-work related chat about meal preparation.
decisions: The technical issue with the corporate web build was discussed but no definitive fix or follow-up action was assigned.
